name: MOTS-c Longevity Foundation Protocol
title: MOTS-c Longevity Foundation Protocol
description: Clinical peptide protocol designed for cellular regeneration and systemic optimization.
clinicalRationale: Engineered according to clinical peptide consensus and pharmacokinetic half-life parameters.
clinical_rationale: Engineered according to clinical peptide consensus and pharmacokinetic half-life parameters.
evidenceGradeNote: Grade B: Combines MOTS-c mitochondrial signal transduction (human Phase I data) with Epithalon telomerase activation and NAD+ cellular energetic restoration. Human longitudinal cohort studies (Khavinson et al.) demonstrate biogerontological biomarker improvement.
evidence_grade_note: Grade B: Combines MOTS-c mitochondrial signal transduction (human Phase I data) with Epithalon telomerase activation and NAD+ cellular energetic restoration. Human longitudinal cohort studies (Khavinson et al.) demonstrate biogerontological biomarker improvement.
contraindications: Active malignancy or uninvestigated neoplastic lesions
Severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh Class C) or end-stage renal disease
relativeCautions: History of cardiac arrhythmia or severe hypertension
Concurrent administration of insulin secretagogues without dose adjustment
expectedOutcomes: Restoration of target cellular and metabolic signaling pathways
Documented improvement in clinical biomarkers and subjective vigor
Sustained systemic resilience and tissue regeneration
